title: G-CARL: Grounded Checklist-Aligned Reward Learning for Patient-Oriented Medical Report Interpretation
abstract: arXiv:2608.20331v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Personalized interpretation of medical reports has emerged as an increasingly important need among patients. Addressing this need requires both evidence-grounded medical factuality and context-dependent patient communication, yet existing medical vision-language tasks do not adequately capture these dual requirements. To bridge this gap, we introduce Patient-oriented Medical Report Interpretation (PMRI), a novel open-ended multimodal generation task that requires models to explain medical reports in accurate and accessible language based on a user's query and dialogue history. translated_title: G-CARL：面向患者医学报告解读的基于核对表的对齐奖励学习
translated_abstract: 摘要：医学报告的个人化解读已成为患者日益增长的需求。满足这一需求既需要基于证据的医学事实性，又需要依赖于情境的患者沟通，但现有的医学视觉-语言任务未能充分捕捉这些双重需求。为弥补这一差距，我们引入了面向患者的医学报告解读（PMRI），这是一个新颖的开放式多模态生成任务，要求模型根据用户的查询和对话历史，以准确且易于理解的语言解释医学报告。这两个目标在可验证性上根本不同，但又紧密耦合，使得在传统的监督微调和整体强化学习范式下难以联合优化。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了G-CARL，一种基于核对表对齐的强化学习框架，结合了多源检索。
tldr: 本文提出G-CARL框架，通过基于核对表的强化学习，解决了医学报告解读中事实性与患者沟通双重目标的联合优化难题，实现了面向患者的准确且易理解的报告解释。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes G-CARL, a checklist-aligned reinforcement learning framework that addresses the joint optimization of factual accuracy and patient-oriented communication in medical report interpretation, enabling accurate and accessible explanations for patients.
